origin.upbringing.civmod.woodcutters: I grew up in a family of woodcutters.
origin.upbringing.civmod.miners: My family dug for stone and ore for generations.
origin.upbringing.civmod.fisher_folk: I grew up on boats and river banks, in a family of fishers.
origin.upbringing.civmod.farmers: My family worked the fields and the hedgerows.
origin.upbringing.civmod.craftsfolk: I grew up in a family of craftspeople.
origin.upbringing.civmod.smelters: My family kept furnaces burning for as long as anyone remembers.
origin.upbringing.civmod.wanderers: My family never stayed in one place for long.
origin.upbringing.civmod.minstrels: I grew up with songs, in a family of minstrels.
origin.upbringing.civmod.temple_keepers: My family kept a small shrine and tended its pilgrims.
origin.upbringing.civmod.innkeepers: I grew up in my family's inn, pouring drinks before I could reach the counter.
origin.upbringing.civmod.record_keepers: My family counted grain and kept the books for the whole district.
origin.upbringing.civmod.couriers: My family carried goods and letters from place to place.
origin.upbringing.civmod.stewards: My family ran the affairs of a lord's estate.
origin.upbringing.civmod.woodland_family: I grew up at the edge of the woods, felling trees and gathering what grew beneath them.
origin.upbringing.civmod.stone_and_sea: My family cut stone in the hills and fished in the bay.
origin.turning_point.civmod.famine: The harvest failed two years in a row.
origin.turning_point.civmod.plague: A sickness took half of the people I knew.
origin.turning_point.civmod.lost_trade: The trade that fed us dried up overnight.
origin.turning_point.civmod.collapse: Our house collapsed in a storm and we could not rebuild.
origin.turning_point.civmod.drought: The wells ran dry and the herds died.
origin.turning_point.civmod.sandstorm: A sandstorm buried everything we owned.
origin.turning_point.civmod.grass_fire: A fire swept through the dry grass and took the farm.
origin.turning_point.civmod.flood: The river broke its banks and washed the village away.
origin.turning_point.civmod.shipwreck: Our boat went down in a storm and I was the only one who came ashore.
origin.turning_point.civmod.hungry_wolve: A hard winter drove the wolves down to our door.
origin.turning_point.civmod.conscription: Soldiers marched through and took the men away.
origin.reason.civmod.survivors: Few of us got out alive, and we ended up here.
origin.reason.civmod.followed_prayer: I heard a prayer in my sleep and followed it here.
origin.reason.civmod.seeking_shelter: Word reached me that this place takes in people with nowhere to go.
origin.reason.civmod.saw_the_shrine: I kept walking until I saw the shrine, and then I stayed.
origin.reason.civmod.village_too_poor: The village could not feed all of us any more.
origin.reason.civmod.offered_bread: Somebody offered me bread and a bed, so I came along.
origin.reason.civmod.tired_of_waiting: I was tired of waiting for things to get better.
origin.reason.civmod.brought_out: People from the settlement brought me out of danger.
origin.reason.civmod.escorted_here: They walked me here themselves and promised me a roof.
origin.reason.civmod.wandered_in: I wandered in and nobody sent me away.
origin.reason.civmod.lost_my_way: I lost my way on the road and found people here.
origin.reason.civmod.passing_through: I was passing through and saw the lights of your inn.
origin.reason.civmod.looking_for_work: I am looking for work, and a settlement is a good place to ask.
origin.reason.civmod.heard_of_this_place: I heard about this place on the road and wanted to see it for myself.

civmod.talk.small.weather.good.1: The sky is clear. A good day for work.
civmod.talk.small.weather.good.2: I like it when the sun is out.
civmod.talk.small.weather.bad.0: This weather gets into my bones.
civmod.talk.small.weather.bad.1: Rain again. I hope the roof holds.
civmod.talk.small.weather.bad.2: Such a gloomy day. I would rather sit by the fire.
civmod.talk.small.settlement.bed.0: I would love a real bed instead of straw.
civmod.talk.small.settlement.bed.1: My back aches from sleeping on straw.
civmod.talk.small.settlement.bed.2: A proper bed would do me a lot of good.
civmod.talk.small.settlement.fire.0: The nights are cold. A fire close to my bed would help.
civmod.talk.small.settlement.fire.1: I wish there were a hearth near where I sleep.
civmod.talk.small.settlement.fire.2: Nights are cold without a fire nearby.
civmod.talk.small.settlement.food.2: There is not much for me to eat right now.
civmod.talk.small.settlement.fine.0: I have a bed, a fire and food. I cannot complain.
civmod.talk.small.settlement.fine.2: I am glad I ended up in this place.
civmod.talk.small.time.morning.0: Good morning. The day has only just begun.
civmod.talk.small.time.morning.1: Mornings are a good time to get things done.
civmod.talk.small.time.morning.2: The day is still young. There is plenty to do.
civmod.talk.small.time.afternoon.0: The afternoon is going by quickly.
civmod.talk.small.time.afternoon.1: Half the day is behind us already.
civmod.talk.small.time.afternoon.2: It will not be long until the evening.
civmod.talk.small.time.evening.0: The day is nearly over. I am looking forward to the evening.
civmod.talk.small.time.evening.1: Evening already. Where did the day go?
civmod.talk.small.time.evening.2: I like the evenings best, when the work is done.
civmod.talk.small.job.fine.2: I have nothing to complain about.
